087        @Override
088        public void advanceMission(float amount) {
089                float days = Global.getSector().getClock().convertToDays(amount);
090
091                RepLevel level = faction.getRelToPlayer().getLevel();
092                if (!level.isAtWorst(RepLevel.NEUTRAL)) {
093                        setMissionResult(new MissionResult(-1, null));
094                        setMissionState(MissionState.COMPLETED);
095                        endMission();
096                        sendUpdateIfPlayerHasIntel(missionResult, false);
097                } else {
098                        makeRepChanges(null);
099                }
100        }

122        public void endMission(InteractionDialogAPI dialog) {
123                log.info(String.format("Ending commission with [%s]", faction.getDisplayName()));
124                Global.getSector().getListenerManager().removeListener(this);
125                Global.getSector().removeScript(this);
126                
127                Global.getSector().getCharacterData().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset(MemFlags.FCM_FACTION);
128                Global.getSector().getCharacterData().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().unset(MemFlags.FCM_EVENT);
129                
130                //sendUpdate(new Object(), dialog == null ? null : dialog.getTextPanel());
131                //sendUpdateIfPlayerHasIntel(new Object(), false, true);
132                
133                undoAllRepChanges(dialog);
134                
135                //endAfterDelay();
136                endImmediately();
137                
138                ListenerUtil.reportCommissionEnded(this);
139        }
140        
141        public void makeRepChanges(InteractionDialogAPI dialog) {       
142                FactionAPI player = Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction();
143                for (FactionAPI other : getRelevantFactions()) {
144                        RepChangeData change = repChanges.get(other.getId());
145
146                        boolean madeHostile = change != null;
147                        boolean factionHostile = faction.isHostileTo(other);
148                        boolean playerHostile = player.isHostileTo(other); 
149                        
150                        if (factionHostile && !playerHostile && !madeHostile) {
151                                makeHostile(other, dialog);
152                        }
153                        
154                        if (!factionHostile && madeHostile) {
155                                undoRepChange(other, dialog);
156                        }
157                }
158        }
159        
160        public void makeHostile(FactionAPI other, InteractionDialogAPI dialog) {
161                ReputationAdjustmentResult rep = Global.getSector().adjustPlayerReputation(
162                                new RepActionEnvelope(RepActions.MAKE_HOSTILE_AT_BEST, 
163                                null, null, dialog != null ? dialog.getTextPanel() : null, false, true), 
164                                other.getId());
165                
166                RepChangeData data = new RepChangeData();
167                data.faction = other;
168                data.delta = rep.delta;
169                repChanges.put(other.getId(), data);
170        }
171        
172        public void undoRepChange(FactionAPI other, InteractionDialogAPI dialog) {
173                String id = other.getId();
174                RepChangeData change = repChanges.get(id);
175                
176                if (change == null) return;
177                
178                CustomRepImpact impact = new CustomRepImpact();
179                impact.delta = -change.delta;
180                impact.delta = Math.max(0f, impact.delta - Global.getSettings().getFloat("factionCommissionRestoredRelationshipPenalty"));
181                if (impact.delta > 0) {
182                        Global.getSector().adjustPlayerReputation(
183                                        new RepActionEnvelope(RepActions.CUSTOM, 
184                                                        impact, null, dialog != null ? dialog.getTextPanel() : null, false, true), 
185                                                        id);
186                }
187                repChanges.remove(id);
188        }
189        
190        public void undoAllRepChanges(InteractionDialogAPI dialog) {
191                for (RepChangeData data : new ArrayList<RepChangeData>(repChanges.values())) {
192                        undoRepChange(data.faction, dialog);
193                }
194        }

197        public List<FactionAPI> getRelevantFactions() {
198                Set<FactionAPI> factions = new LinkedHashSet<FactionAPI>();
199                for (MarketAPI market : Global.getSector().getEconomy().getMarketsCopy()) {
200                        if (market.isHidden()) continue;
201                        FactionAPI curr = market.getFaction();
202                        if (factions.contains(curr)) continue;
203                        
204                        if (curr.isShowInIntelTab()) {
205                                factions.add(curr);
206                        }
207                }
208        
209                return new ArrayList<FactionAPI>(factions);
210        }
211        public List<FactionAPI> getHostileFactions() {
212                FactionAPI player = Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction();
213                List<FactionAPI> hostile = new ArrayList<FactionAPI>();
214                for (FactionAPI other : getRelevantFactions()) {
215                        if (this.faction.isHostileTo(other)) {
216                                hostile.add(other);
217                        }
218                }
219                return hostile;
220        }

223        public float computeStipend() {
224                int officers = 0;
225                CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
226                if (playerFleet != null) {
227                        for (OfficerDataAPI od : playerFleet.getFleetData().getOfficersCopy()) {
228                                if (!od.isActivated()) continue;
229                                if (Misc.isMercenary(od.getPerson())) continue;
230                                officers++;
231                        }
232                }
233                
234                float mult = Misc.isExtended() ? Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_commissionMonthlyIncomeMult") : 1f;
235                
236                return (Global.getSettings().getFloat("factionCommissionStipendBase") +
237                           Global.getSettings().getFloat("factionCommissionStipendPerOfficer") * officers) * mult;
238        }

243        public void reportBattleOccurred(CampaignFleetAPI fleet, CampaignFleetAPI primaryWinner, BattleAPI battle) {
244                if (isEnded() || isEnding()) return;
245                
246                if (!battle.isPlayerInvolved()) return;
247                
248                int payment = 0;
249                float fpDestroyed = 0;
250                for (CampaignFleetAPI otherFleet : battle.getNonPlayerSideSnapshot()) {
251                        if (!faction.isHostileTo(otherFleet.getFaction())) continue;
252                        if (otherFleet.getFaction() != null && otherFleet.getFaction().getCustomBoolean(Factions.CUSTOM_NO_BOUNTY_FOR_DEFEATING)) {
253                                continue;
254                        }
255                        
256                        float bounty = 0;
257                        for (FleetMemberAPI loss : Misc.getSnapshotMembersLost(otherFleet)) {
258                                float mult = Misc.getSizeNum(loss.getHullSpec().getHullSize());
259                                bounty += mult * baseBounty;
260                                fpDestroyed += loss.getFleetPointCost();
261                        }
262                        
263                        payment += (int) (bounty * battle.getPlayerInvolvementFraction());
264                }
265        
266                if (payment > 0) {
267                        Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getCargo().getCredits().add(payment);
268                        
269                        float repFP = (int)(fpDestroyed * battle.getPlayerInvolvementFraction());
270                        ReputationAdjustmentResult rep = Global.getSector().adjustPlayerReputation(
271                                                        new RepActionEnvelope(RepActions.COMMISSION_BOUNTY_REWARD, new Float(repFP), null, null, true, false), 
272                                                        faction.getId());
273                        latestResult = new CommissionBountyResult(payment, battle.getPlayerInvolvementFraction(), rep);
274                        sendUpdateIfPlayerHasIntel(latestResult, false);
275                }
276        }

278        protected void addBulletPoints(TooltipMakerAPI info, ListInfoMode mode) {
279                
280                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
281                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
282                float pad = 3f;
283                float opad = 10f;
284                
285                float initPad = pad;
286                if (mode == ListInfoMode.IN_DESC) initPad = opad;
287                
288                Color tc = getBulletColorForMode(mode);
289                
290                bullet(info);
291                boolean isUpdate = getListInfoParam() != null;
292                
293                if (getListInfoParam() == UPDATE_PARAM_ACCEPTED) {
294                        return;
295                }
296                if (getListInfoParam() == UPDATE_PARAM_ANNULLED) {
297                        return;
298                }
299                
300                if (missionResult != null && missionResult.payment < 0) {
301//                      info.addPara("Annulled by " + faction.getDisplayNameWithArticle(), initPad, tc,
302//                                      faction.getBaseUIColor(), faction.getDisplayNameWithArticleWithoutArticle());
303                } else if (isUpdate && latestResult != null) {
304                        info.addPara("%s received", initPad, tc, h, Misc.getDGSCredits(latestResult.payment));
305                        if (Math.round(latestResult.fraction * 100f) < 100f) {
306                                info.addPara("%s share based on damage dealt", 0f, tc, h, 
307                                                "" + (int) Math.round(latestResult.fraction * 100f) + "%");
308                        }
309                        CoreReputationPlugin.addAdjustmentMessage(latestResult.rep1.delta, faction, null, 
310                                                                                                          null, null, info, tc, isUpdate, 0f);
311                } else if (mode == ListInfoMode.IN_DESC) {
312                        info.addPara("%s base bounty per hostile frigate", initPad, tc, h, Misc.getDGSCredits(baseBounty));
313                        info.addPara("%s monthly stipend", 0f, tc, h, Misc.getDGSCredits(computeStipend()));
314                } else {
315//                      info.addPara("Faction: " + faction.getDisplayName(), initPad, tc,
316//                                      faction.getBaseUIColor(), faction.getDisplayName());
317//                      initPad = 0f;
318                        info.addPara("%s base reward per frigate", initPad, tc, h, Misc.getDGSCredits(baseBounty));
319                        info.addPara("%s monthly stipend", 0f, tc, h, Misc.getDGSCredits(computeStipend()));
320                }
321                unindent(info);
322        }

341        public String getName() {
342                String prefix = Misc.ucFirst(faction.getPersonNamePrefix()) + " Commission";
343//              if (plugin != null) {
344//                      String override = plugin.getNameOverride();
345//                      if (override != null) {
346//                              prefix = override;
347//                      }
348//              }
349                if (isEnding()) {
350                        if (missionResult != null && missionResult.payment < 0) {
351                                if (isSendingUpdate()) {
352                                        return prefix + " - Annulled";
353                                }
354                                return prefix + " - Annulled";
355                                //return prefix + " (Annulled)";
356                        }
357                        //return prefix + " (Resigned)";
358                        return prefix + " - Resigned";
359                }
360                if (isSendingUpdate() && getListInfoParam() == UPDATE_PARAM_ACCEPTED) {
361                        //return prefix + " Accepted";
362                        return prefix + " - Accepted";
363                }
364                if (isSendingUpdate() && getListInfoParam() == UPDATE_PARAM_ANNULLED) {
365                        return prefix + " - Annulled";
366                }
367                return prefix;
368        }

386        public void createSmallDescription(TooltipMakerAPI info, float width, float height, 
387                                                                           boolean forMarketConditionTooltip) {
388                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
389                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
390                Color tc = Misc.getTextColor();
391                float pad = 3f;
392                float opad = 10f;
393
394                info.addImage(faction.getLogo(), width, 128, opad);
395                
396                
397                if (isEnding()) {
398                        if (missionResult != null && missionResult.payment < 0) {
399                                info.addPara("Your commission was annulled by " + faction.getDisplayNameWithArticle() + 
400                                                " due to your standing falling too low.",
401                                                 opad, faction.getBaseUIColor(),
402                                                 faction.getDisplayNameWithArticleWithoutArticle());
403                                
404                                CoreReputationPlugin.addRequiredStanding(faction, Commission.COMMISSION_REQ, null, null, info, tc, opad, true);
405                                CoreReputationPlugin.addCurrentStanding(faction, null, null, info, tc, opad);
406                        } else {
407                                info.addPara("You've resigned your commission with " + faction.getDisplayNameWithArticle() + 
408                                                ".",
409                                                 opad, faction.getBaseUIColor(),
410                                                 faction.getDisplayNameWithArticleWithoutArticle());
411                        }
412                } else {
413                        info.addPara("You've accepted a %s commission.",
414                                        opad, faction.getBaseUIColor(), Misc.ucFirst(faction.getPersonNamePrefix()));
415                        
416                        addBulletPoints(info, ListInfoMode.IN_DESC);
417                        
418                        info.addPara("The combat bounty payment depends on the number and size of ships destroyed.", opad);
419                }
420                
421                if (latestResult != null) {
422                        //Color color = faction.getBaseUIColor();
423                        //Color dark = faction.getDarkUIColor();
424                        //info.addSectionHeading("Most Recent Reward", color, dark, Alignment.MID, opad);
425                        info.addPara("Most recent bounty:", opad);
426                        bullet(info);
427                        info.addPara("%s received", opad, tc, h, Misc.getDGSCredits(latestResult.payment));
428                        if (Math.round(latestResult.fraction * 100f) < 100f) {
429                                info.addPara("%s share based on damage dealt", 0f, tc, h, 
430                                                "" + (int) Math.round(latestResult.fraction * 100f) + "%");
431                        }
432                        CoreReputationPlugin.addAdjustmentMessage(latestResult.rep1.delta, faction, null, 
433                                                                                                          null, null, info, tc, false, 0f);
434                        unindent(info);
435                }
436
437                if (!isEnding() && !isEnded()) {
438                        boolean plMember = PerseanLeagueMembership.isLeagueMember();
439                        if (!plMember) {
440                                addAbandonButton(info, width, "Resign commission");
441                        } else {
442                                info.addPara("You can not resign your commission while polities under your "
443                                                + "control are members of the League.", opad);
444                        }
445                }
446        }

472        public MissionResult createResignedCommissionResult(boolean withPenalty, boolean inPerson, InteractionDialogAPI dialog) {
473                if (withPenalty) {
474                        CustomRepImpact impact = new CustomRepImpact();
475                        impact.delta = -1f * Global.getSettings().getFloat("factionCommissionResignPenalty");
476                        if (inPerson) {
477                                impact.delta = -1f * Global.getSettings().getFloat("factionCommissionResignPenaltyInPerson");
478                        }
479                        ReputationAdjustmentResult rep = Global.getSector().adjustPlayerReputation(
480                                        new RepActionEnvelope(RepActions.CUSTOM, 
481                                                        impact, null, dialog != null ? dialog.getTextPanel() : null, false, true), 
482                                                        faction.getId());
483                        return new MissionResult();
484                }
485                return new MissionResult();
486        }

511        public void reportEconomyTick(int iterIndex) {
512                
513                float numIter = Global.getSettings().getFloat("economyIterPerMonth");
514                float f = 1f / numIter;
515                
516                //CampaignFleetAPI playerFleet = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
517                MonthlyReport report = SharedData.getData().getCurrentReport();
518                
519                FDNode fleetNode = report.getNode(MonthlyReport.FLEET);
520                fleetNode.name = "Fleet";
521                fleetNode.custom = MonthlyReport.FLEET;
522                fleetNode.tooltipCreator = report.getMonthlyReportTooltip();
523                
524                float stipend = computeStipend();
525                FDNode stipendNode = report.getNode(fleetNode, "node_id_stipend_" + faction.getId());
526                stipendNode.income += stipend * f;
527                
528                if (stipendNode.name == null) {
529                        stipendNode.name = faction.getDisplayName() + " Commission";
530                        stipendNode.icon = faction.getCrest();
531                        stipendNode.tooltipCreator = new TooltipCreator() {
532                                public boolean isTooltipExpandable(Object tooltipParam) {
533                                        return false;
534                                }
535                                public float getTooltipWidth(Object tooltipParam) {
536                                        return 450;
537                                }
538                                public void createTooltip(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean expanded, Object tooltipParam) {
539                                        tooltip.addPara("Your monthly stipend for holding a " + faction.getDisplayName() + " commission", 0f);
540                                }
541                        };
542                }
543                
544//              if (plugin != null) {
545//                      plugin.reportEconomyTick(iterIndex);
546//              }
547        }
